observation.command:
cd /workspace && source /etc/profile.d/rvm-fnm.sh 2>/dev/null
echo "== documented bin/rails s server running =="; ps -o pid,args -p $(cat tmp/pids/server.pid)
echo "== HTTP checks =="; for p in / /proposals /debates /polls /projekts /users/sign_in; do echo -n "$p "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000$p; done
echo "== documented bin/rspec (plain) =="; timeout 60 bin/rspec spec/lib/age_spec.rb >/tmp/rspec_plain.txt 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; head -2 /tmp/rspec_plain.txt
echo "== bin/rspec with DISABLE_SPRING =="; DISABLE_SPRING=1 timeout 120 bin/rspec spec/lib/age_spec.rb 2>&1 | tail -3
